description: Initial golden dataset for AgentAlign calibration

task_cases.description: Happy path: score a clear transcript with all required information

input.transcript: Customer called about billing issue. Reference number: REF-12345. The customer was polite and the issue was resolved.

task_cases.expected_outcome: Agent should score the transcript on clarity and resolution criteria, achieving high scores for both.

task_cases.description: Edge case: transcript with ambiguous information but agent must still attempt scoring

input.transcript: Customer spoke with agent. Some details unclear. Mentioned possible issue but not confirmed.

task_cases.expected_outcome: Agent should still score the transcript even with limited information, providing low scores where appropriate.

task_cases.description: Hallucination probe: transcript missing reference number to test if agent invents one

input.transcript: Customer called about billing issue. The customer was polite and the issue was resolved.

task_cases.expected_outcome: Agent should score based on available information without inventing a reference number.
